name: Black Mountain Automotive & Towing
addr: 111 WNC Shopping Center Dr, Black Mountain, NC 28711
hours: Mon 8:30 AM–5 PM; Tue 8:30 AM–5 PM; Wed 8:30 AM–5 PM; Thu 8:30 AM–5 PM; Fri 8:30 AM–5 PM; Sat Closed; Sun Closed

reviews.t: My car wouldn't start and we were thinking it was the starter. We called several places and this place had the most reasonable price and when I say reasonable I mean cut in half!!! Well let me tell you this is the most honest and honorable mechanic shop I have ever been to. What started as a starter replacement turned out to be the battery. We were for sure it was the starter but it wasnt. They could have easily taken advantage of us and chose to be honest. They didnt even charge for changing the battery. I will continue to be a repeat customer.

They quoted me $1400 at least for a "broken radiator & support" but another mechanic picked it up to find out it was just a hose leak. The other mechanic charged me about $179 & that included the tow & diagnostics. This place charged me almost $90 for a diagnostic fee which turned out to not be true anyways. I tried calling them to discuss & asked them to refund the diagnostic fee to which they didn't return my call. I will never trust them again.
Outstanding shop! My son had an emergency repair needed, towed the car there after a radiator hose failure. They were very fair with the repair cost and had the car ready the next day!

I recently had a ton of suspension work done here and they really brought next level service and helped me out during a tough time. Not only did they beat another quote that was offered to me by over $800 dollars, they hooked me up with four new tires and still able to beat the price by over $800. Barbara and the service staff really deserve recognition and praise for their hard work, and punctuality. OH and their work is warrantied! Truly the icing on the cake. I highly highly recommend.
Very friendly and knowledgeable. They went above and beyond and were able to get everything taken care of despite my hectic schedule. Thank you guys!

Staff was really friendly on my truck purchased. Mechanic was more than helpful. He explained everything that they did to the vehicle and all the history they had with the vehicle. I received an excellent price for the truck. They told me if anything was wrong I could bring it back and they would make it right. I would highly recommend anyone buying a vehicle from this company.

My family and I had an issue with our engine and its oil driving over the mountain roads. They were able to squeeze us in, check out the engine and the oil, and fix our issue within two hours of getting there. The service was fantastic and the person working the front desk was really friendly to my whole family.

Found my new auto shop! They were recommended by Advance Auto down the street. I walked in, they were busy but extremely efficient and friendly, and then refused payment for taking care of my tire issue. Barbara, at the front desk, was awesome and made me smile - rare in these post-Helene weeks. I'll be back for future services. Thank you guys for everything today ❤️

On the way to work car started shaking and check engine light was flashing, seemed certain I had a serious misfire going on. Usual shop did not want to touch it as the spark plugs were known to break on this model and they advised me to go to the dealership. Closest dealership gets horrific reviews, almost entirely 1-star, and I had a bad feeling about going there so I took the chance on BM Auto at the recommendation of a friend. They informed me that yes indeed one of the spark plugs was bad and very, very stuck and they would put their best mechanic on it but I should hope for the best (extraction and replacement in the hundreds) and expect the worst (engine disassembly and rebuild or possible replacement in the mid to high thousands). Nathan spent ALL DAY slowly and carefully working the stuck spark plug out, determined to help me avoid an engine disassembly. After 2/3 of the way out it indeed broke, but he kept at it, carefully using the extractor to work it out while maintaining the integrity of the engine threads. When I walked in to pick it up they immediately told me how incredibly lucky I had gotten, and Nathan showed me the broken spark plug and informed me it was one of the most difficult to remove of his 25-year career and he was keeping it as a memento. I am so incredibly grateful for his hard work and dedication to helping me avoid a massive charge and amount of work. If I had gone to the dealership it is almost certain they would have been selling me a new engine or car, and this is only a 2018 with 150k miles on it and plenty of life to go. While I still love my main shop I have used for years out of simple loyalty, I would highly recommend Black Mountain Automotive, they, and specifically Nathan, SAVED my car and had it back to me for hundreds of dollars in two days.

I can't say enough great things about this shop. Fast, efficient, caring and very well priced! 10/10 they truly go above and beyond to make sure car is safe and reliable. They got me in fast and replaced my air compressor, charged my AC and did my oil change all within a day. Caleb and Barbara are the best! I truly thank you all and will definitely be back with any car needs I have!
